heading: top-center
name: 置中標題組＋直排次要文字搭配橫式圖片的分隔線網格
desc: 標題組置中並跨在區塊上緣；下方網格的每個項目左側是一欄直排次要文字、右側是橫式圖片，欄與欄之間有直向分隔線，底部置中一顆按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字，沒有時省略；區塊本身不往上移，只有標題組往上移，跨在本區塊和上一個區塊的交界上：小標籤落在上一個區塊的範圍內，大標題的第一行壓在交界線上。本區塊要有自己的實色底色，而且和上一個區塊的底色不同（例如淺色底），交界線才看得出來；區塊上方用區塊內的上方留白（不是外距，也不是負邊距）容納往上移的標題組，這段留白的底色和上一個區塊相同、不能透明，整個區塊從上到下都不能透出底下的內容，也不能蓋到上一個區塊的內容。標題組下方是多個項目排成的網格，數欄，每列數量依內容而定，項目等寬，欄與欄之間有直向分隔線，最外側沒有線。每個項目無外框：上半部左側是一欄窄的直排次要文字，旋轉成直向、由下往上讀，可放兩段次要文字並以短線隔開，第二段沒有時省略，這一欄與圖片上緣對齊；右側是橫式圖片，約佔項目寬度的七成多，所有項目的圖片同一比例；下半部是靠左的標題（可多行）。網格下方置中放一顆按鈕，沒有時省略。
mobile: 網格改為直向堆疊，每列一個項目、橫跨內容寬度；欄間的直向分隔線改為項目之間的橫向分隔線。每個項目仍是左側直排次要文字欄、右側橫式圖片，標題在下方。標題組維持上方置中並跨在區塊上緣，按鈕在區塊最下方置中。觸控裝置上取消滑過時的圖片傾斜效果。

en.name: Centered heading group + divided grid of vertical secondary text beside landscape images
en.desc: A centered heading group straddles the top edge of the section; below it, a grid where each item has a narrow column of vertically set secondary text on the left and a landscape image on the right, with vertical dividers between columns and a centered button at the bottom.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description below; omit them when there is no content. The section itself is not pulled up; only the heading group is moved up so it straddles the boundary between this section and the previous one: the label sits within the previous section and the first line of the headline lies on the boundary line. This section has its own solid background color that differs from the previous section (for example a light tint) so the boundary is visible. The raised heading group sits in this section's own top padding (not an outer margin and not a negative margin); that padding uses the same background color as the previous section and is never transparent, so nothing underneath shows through anywhere in the section and nothing covers the previous section's content. Below the heading group, multiple items are arranged in a grid with several columns, the number per row depending on the content; items are equal width, with vertical dividers between columns and no line on the outer sides. Each item has no frame: in its upper part, a narrow column of secondary text on the left is rotated to read vertically, reading from bottom to top, and can hold two pieces of secondary text separated by a short line, the second omitted when there is no content; this column aligns with the top edge of the image. On the right is a landscape image taking a little over seven tenths of the item width, with all items' images in the same proportion. In the lower part is a left-aligned title (may wrap to multiple lines). Below the grid, place a centered button; omit it when there is no content.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The grid becomes a vertical stack with one item per row spanning the content width; the vertical dividers between columns become horizontal dividers between items. Each item still has the vertically set secondary text column on the left and the landscape image on the right, with the title below. The heading group stays at the top, centered, still straddling the top edge of the section, and the button is centered at the very bottom of the section. On touch devices, the image tilt on hover is removed.

extras.name: 滑過項目時圖片傾斜
extras.prompt: 滑鼠移到項目上時，該項目的圖片微微傾斜，移開後恢復。
extras.mobile: 觸控裝置上取消傾斜效果，圖片維持正放。

en.name: Image tilts on item hover
en.prompt: When the mouse moves over an item, that item's image tilts slightly, returning to normal when the mouse leaves.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the mobile layout.
en.mobile: On touch devices the tilt effect is removed and the image stays upright.
